sn47.39:1.1: Catunnam bhikkhave satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvanaṃ desissāmi || taṃ suṇātha || || Katamā ca bhikkhave catunnam satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvanā || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyanupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassam || Vedanāsu || Citte || Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ Ayam bhikkhave catunnam satipaṭṭhānānam bhāvanā ti || ||
